title: Backward removal
prompt: Implement `void removeEvens(ArrayList<Integer> nums)`: remove every even number in place. The backward loop is the intended discipline — a forward loop will fail on consecutive evens like [4, 6].

tests.name: evens removed
tests.hint: for (int i = nums.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (nums.get(i) % 2 == 0) nums.remove(i);
